text: Oh, damn, they canceled my visa. Oh, yay, a new MasterCard. What?

text: Are you hoping to get it telepathically?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I think you mean telekinetically. And no. I just wasn't sure of the proper protocol now that you and Leonard are no longer having coitus.

text: God, can we please just say no longer seeing each other?

text: Well, we could if it were true. But as you live in the same building, you see each other all the time. The variable which has changed is the coitus.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, here's the protocol. You and I are still friends, and you stop saying coitus.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Good. I'm glad we're still friends. Oh, yes. It was a lot of work to accommodate you in my life. I'd hate for that effort to have been in vain. Just to be clear. Do I have to stop saying coitus with everyone, or just you?

text: Really?

text: Right.

text: Harsh terms. But alright, I'll just substitute intercourse. Or fornication. But that has judgmental overtones, so I'll hold that in reserve.

speaker: Penny
text: Great.

speaker: Penny
text: So, how you been?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, my existence is a continuum, so I've been what I am at each point in the implied time period.

speaker: Penny
text: You're just coitus-ing with me, aren't you?

text: How's Leonard doing?

text: He seems alright. Although he does spend a disturbing amount of time looking at photographs of you and smelling the pillow you slept on. Although now that I think of it, he asked me not to tell you that.

text: I'll pretend I didn't hear it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'd rather you pretend I didn't say it. I see you bought Mama Italia Marinara Spaghetti Sauce.

text: That's the sauce my mother uses. She likes cooking Italian because according to her, that's what the Romans made Jesus eat.

text: Interesting. I'll have to have you over for spaghetti some night.

text: I'm hungry now.

text: Oh, um, okay. Why don't you give me an hour and come over?

text: Will you cut up hot dogs into little chunks and mix them in with the sauce?

text: It's alright, I do. Oh, you're in for what my mother calls a real Italian treat. I was talking with Penny.

text: Hey, where you been? What's wrong with you? You can't hang out with your roommate's ex? No, it's fine. I don't care. I'm over it.
